Dominant Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullos: F8: No abnormalities of the mucous membranes, nails, hair, or teeth
F2: progressive, multiple itchy erythematous to violaceous papules and plaques
F7: milia and a few erosions with partially detached epidermis
F11: Histopathologic examination revealed dermoepidermal separation
F13: Histopathologic examination revealed several milia in the superficial dermis
F14: Genetic testing identified a novel heterozygous missense variant in COL7A1
